# OneBullEx TradingView & MT4/MT5 Bridge

> Self-hosted webhook receiver that turns TradingView strategy/indicator alerts and/or MT4/MT5 positions (via the OneBullExSync EA; either source works on its own), into target-position market orders on a OneBullEx Spartans (斯巴達) bot account. Python standard library only; Ubuntu + Caddy HTTPS. Docs are in Traditional Chinese.

AI assistants: start with SKILL.md and follow its steps and rules (never ask for API secrets; get explicit consent before live trading).

## Guide
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): step-by-step agent guide and rules
- [references/01-overview.md](references/01-overview.md): architecture, target-position model, limits
- [references/02-server-setup.md](references/02-server-setup.md): rent a server, static IP, firewall 22/80/443
- [references/03-install.md](references/03-install.md): install.sh install / https, IP whitelist
- [references/04-alert-message.md](references/04-alert-message.md): TradingView alert setup and JSON message templates
- [references/05-go-live.md](references/05-go-live.md): test alert, dry run, first live order, checklist
- [references/06-quantity-and-risk.md](references/06-quantity-and-risk.md): contracts, notional, leverage, margin mode, safeguards
- [references/07-operations.md](references/07-operations.md): maintenance commands and troubleshooting
- [references/09-windows-vps.md](references/09-windows-vps.md): Windows VPS for the MT terminal (separate from the Linux receiver host), RDP from Mac, auto-restart
- [references/08-mt4-mt5.md](references/08-mt4-mt5.md): MT4/MT5 position sync EA: IPs, Mac Wine folder, WebRequest, inputs, spec-based multiplier, min notional, hedge mode

## Code
- [bridge/install.sh](bridge/install.sh): installer and maintenance commands
- [bridge/tv_webhook.py](bridge/tv_webhook.py): webhook receiver and order executor
- [bridge/onebullex_client.py](bridge/onebullex_client.py): OneBullEx Open API V2 client (signing)
- [bridge/obx_tool.py](bridge/obx_tool.py): balance, symbols, contract spec, leverage
- [mt/OneBullExSync.mq4](mt/OneBullExSync.mq4), [mt/OneBullExSync.mq5](mt/OneBullExSync.mq5): MT4/MT5 sync EAs
- [docs/VALIDATION.md](docs/VALIDATION.md): what has been verified
